messages.subject: demo problem version 2.0.1
parts:
Hi all,

I was running the seewave demo (very cool!). It produces an error in the following code:

spectro(tico, f=22050, ovlp=50, palette=rev.gray.colors.2, scale=FALSE)
Hit <Return> to see next plot:
Error in .filled.contour(as.double(x), as.double(y), z, as.double(levels),  :
  object 'rev.gray.colors.2' not found


I guess is due to the change in palette names in the new version.

Cheers


Marcelo
